package: TechOps Hero — Good Dogs Campaign Clips v2.2 PIXEL
notes: Canonical Triple Jump clip replaced with the 7.03s 910x512 upload supplied on 2026-08-31. It begins in Sector 04 Docking Bay, shows the linked dog traversal through the laser grid, and ends at the Cell 118 MIKE OLIVEFIELD terminal.
Updated flow removes the extra orbital-arrival segment from the opening and uses the picked cockpit takeover and crash clips supplied on 2026-09-03.
New Triple Jump clip is integrated as the Cell 118 prelude and must play immediately before the K reveal cutscene.
K visual canon follows the newer orbital/cell footage: beanie, sunglasses, black tactical outfit. Do not substitute the drifted blue-jacket or generic alternates here.
Waldo visual canon remains red-mask / black-leather presentation during this portion of the campaign.
These clips punctuate gameplay; they do not replace interactive beats like Dock Infiltration, Triple Boost gameplay, Mike Index, Hold the Door, Run the Ring, or the Warden fight.

sequence.title: Signal Beyond Earth
sequence.purpose: First indication that the dogs' rescue signal extends beyond Earth.

sequence.title: Cockpit Pilot Takeover
sequence.purpose: Katrin and Manchez overrun the pilot and take control of the Good Ship before playable asteroid flight.

sequence.title: Orbital Approach
sequence.placement: Immediately after launch, before Dock Infiltration
sequence.purpose: Establishes the improvised shuttle and orbital detention ring as the true destination.

sequence.title: Triple Jump → Cell 118 Terminal
sequence.placement: After Dock Infiltration / traversal setup, immediately before K Reveal
sequence.purpose: Canonical traversal handoff: Katrin and Manchez execute the linked three-jump route through the Sector 04 laser grid and arrive at the Cell 118 terminal.
cohesion_rules: This clip owns the successful traversal payoff; do not immediately replay another jump montage.
Preserve Sector 04 black/red clinical lighting into the K reveal.
End on the MIKE OLIVEFIELD terminal and cut directly into the Cell 118 identity-mismatch scene.
Do not reveal K's final identity inside this clip.
Dog outfits, collar colors, scale, and movement continuity must match the preceding Dock Infiltration state.

sequence.title: Cell 118 / K Reveal
sequence.purpose: Pre-rendered discovery of K. Hands back to canonical dialogue and K-support setup.

sequence.title: K Freed / Prison Escort
sequence.placement: After K is freed and Mike Index resolves
sequence.purpose: Shows K becoming part of the group before the route to 1984.

sequence.title: Cell 1984 Hack
sequence.purpose: K works the prison terminal while the game prepares the defense encounter.

sequence.title: Team Reunited Exit
sequence.purpose: Reunited party beat before Release Was Expected and Warden NULL.

ordered_flow: GD_CUT_04 — Triple Jump → Cell 118 Terminal (canonical 7.03s clip)
Canonical K dialogue and support handoff
visual_rules: Carry the same Sector 04 dock/prison architecture, red laser language, wet reflective floor, and red-black Cell 118 lighting forward.
K's orbital design remains black tactical clothing, black beanie, sunglasses, and green-accent tech.
Waldo remains the red-mask / black-leather canon design later in the prison arc.
The Cell 118 terminal may call the prisoner MIKE OLIVEFIELD before K rejects the classification.
editing_rules: Hard or glitch cut from the terminal close-up into the Cell 118 reveal.
Avoid a second establishing shot of Cell 118; the canonical Triple Jump clip already establishes arrival.
Allow 4-8 frames of terminal hold before the reveal clip if subtitles/state UI need breathing room.
If the cinematic is skipped, write cell118_terminal_seen and begin GD_CUT_05 or its equivalent reveal state immediately.
narrative_rules: The jump clip is action and arrival.
The K reveal is identity disruption.
Mike Index is the player's return to agency and demonstrates prediction mechanically.

video_treatment.name: TechOps Retro Pixel Cutscene Pass
video_treatment.preserves: original edit, motion, audio, frame dimensions and campaign timing
video_treatment.runtime_note: Use these prefiltered files directly; no browser blur/interpolation filter is required.

processed_media.style: picked cockpit pilot takeover clip, web H.264 transcode, no generated overlay
picked authored prison crash clip, web H.264 transcode, no procedural shuttle animation
